svg.title: SingleSourceSearch, step by step
svg.desc: Animated: the generic search on a six-node graph with a zero heuristic, as every scheduler search runs it. Each step pops the cheapest open node, asks the environment whether it is a goal, closes it and asks the environment for its neighbors.
svg.metadata: ["Start: the source S goes into the open set with cost 0 (init_cost plus the heuristic, which is 0). The predecessor map records S as its own predecessor; that is how GetPath later knows where to stop.", "Pop S (cost 0). OnExpansion(S) is false, so S is closed. GetNeighbors(S): A discovered at 4; B discovered at 1.", "Pop B (cost 1). OnExpansion(B) is false, so B is closed. GetNeighbors(B): A improved from 4 to 3 (decrease key, new predecessor B); C discovered at 7; S is closed, skipped.", "Pop A (cost 3). OnExpansion(A) is false, so A is closed. GetNeighbors(A): B is closed, skipped; G discovered at 6; S is closed, skipped.", "G is the cheapest open node. OnExpansion(G) returns true, the environment's goal test, so the search returns at once: SearchSolution keeps the predecessor map and target = G. GetPath(G) walks the predecessors back: G <- A <- B <- S, cost 6. C and D are never expanded."]

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: A generic A* (Dijkstra when the heuristic is zero). The environment decides what a state is, what its neighbors cost and when to stop; the engine only orders the work.
